title: 第1章  宗门强发老婆？还有这种好事？
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
content_zh:
“起来了。”
“宗门发老婆了，还不赶紧的话，就领不到漂亮的婆娘了。”
“长生，还在愣着干嘛？快跟我一起领老婆去。”
李长生被吵杂声吵醒，睁开眼睛，从床上爬起来，穿上道袍。
跟着王麻子往外门广场走去。
外面已是深秋，冷风顺着袖口钻进来，就像纯刀子在割皮肉。
李长生今年六十岁了。
对于凡人而言，六十岁已是耳顺之年，儿孙绕膝；
但对于修仙者，六十岁若还卡在练气三层，那就意味着大道断绝，剩下一堆即将腐朽的枯骨。
他就属于后者。
当李长生走到外门广场时，广场上已经站满了人。
他们皆是被优化的弟子，个个年迈，须发皆白，暮气沉沉。
咳咳……
高台上，庶务长老谢剑，一身锦衣，俯视着众人，声音夹带灵力，冰冷不带任何温度：
“奉宗主令。”
“为整顿宗门资源，凡年满六十，且修为未至练气中期者，即日起被优化，遣散下山。念尔等为宗门效力多年，皆可从亡国奴隶中，挑选一名女子，结为道侣，建立凡人家族。”
“如后代拥有修仙资质可送入宗门，宗门则重重有赏。”
谢剑长老声音音刚落，人群中便响起一阵骚动。
被强行遣退，还发老婆？
还有这种好事。

宗门真是良心了。
李长生站在原地，静静地看着前方。
他穿越到这个世界，已经六十年了。
每天都战战兢兢，如履薄冰，不争不抢，不惹因果。
以为只要苟得住，总能熬出头。
可现实给了他一记响亮的耳光。
资质太差，便是苟到死，也出不了头。
这便是大多数凡人修仙的一生。
在修仙界。
比前世的职场更残酷。
宗门不养闲人，年轻时榨干劳力，老了便一脚踢开。
还让他们去凡间当【生育机器】。
这特么是人能干的事情吗？
谢剑长老挥了挥手，开口：
“事不宜迟。”
“下面开始选妻。”
话音落下，广场侧门
一群衣衫褴褛、神情委顿的女子，在两位执法弟子的驱赶下，走了出来。
这些都是亡国的流民，不知道怎的就被贬为奴隶。
然后送到这里，给这些老头当老婆。

原本死气沉沉的老弟子们，看到眼前如花似玉的婆娘，眼睛瞬间亮了。
宗门发的老婆质量不差啊！
个个都如花似玉，肤白貌美。
而且都是十八到三十岁之间的少女。
说不定其中还有大家闺秀、权贵后代、修士，甚至亡国公主也说不定。
能否挑选到漂亮的老婆。
就看手快手慢了。
“我选这个。我认得是隔壁大公府的人，曾经可是练气修士。正好适合我。”
“我选这个。皮肤白，骨盆大，好生养。”
“我选这个。身上的衣服就显得不凡，一看就是大家闺秀。”
这些被优化的老者，纷纷挑选自己中意的道侣。
唯独李长生没有动。
他不急。
因为别人要的道侣，他都不要。
女人可是麻烦源头。
尤其是这些亡国奴。
李长生不想沾染因果，只准备选一位普通的女子，活到自然老死。
随后其便看到，自己朋友王麻子，选了一位肤白貌美的女子。
该女子身穿锦稠，皮肤白皙胜过牛奶。
一看就是大家闺秀。

真不知道王麻子能不能受得住这一份因果。
李长生心里吐槽一声。
这时王麻子走到李长生面前，一脸高兴，炫耀：
“长生。”
“我选的婆娘漂亮吗？”
李长生回答：“漂亮。”
王麻子闻言，更加高兴了。李长生的回答证明了自己的眼光不错。
随后看到依旧在原地不动的李长生，疑惑地问：
“你怎么还不去挑婆娘？待会好的婆娘都被人挑完了。”
李长生忠厚老实地笑了笑：“如果我不让你们先挑，你们又怎么能挑到好婆娘呢？”
王麻子哈哈一笑。
好像也是啊！
李长生就是一个铁憨憨。
这种东西哪能让的？
李长生等了片刻，等众人选得差不多了，才开始行动。
陈婉儿。
这个太漂亮了，铁定是红颜祸水。
刘如意。
这个有修为？可是灾祸。
也不要。

李长生转了一圈之后，才挑选了一个，没有修为，穿着麻衣，看起来很安全的女子。
该女子看到陈默走过来，躲在墙角位置，瑟瑟发抖。
李长生抬起头，打量了眼前的女子两眼。
胆子小？
胆小好啊！
胆小意味着好控制。
李长生指着那个角落里的少女，开口：
“长老。”
“弟子想要带她下山。”
谢剑闻言，愣了一下，抬头看了一眼李长生，又转过头，看向那个没有修为，长得很安全的少女，皱眉道：
“李长生，你糊涂啊？”
“江翠萍是毫无修为的凡人，你选他干嘛？那你选旁边那几位罪修啊！跟罪修结为道侣，容易诞生有修炼资质的后代。”
李长生闻言，面色平静，腰背微躬，露出一副认命的苦笑。
“弟子自知时日无多，囊中羞涩。”
“只想找个知冷知热的凡人丫头，洗衣做饭，养老送终罢了。”
“还望长老成全。”
执事陈默了一会，挥笔在名册上一勾：
“行吧。”
“人各有志。”
“江翠萍，从今日起，你便随李长生下山吧。”

“谢长老。”李长生拱手拜谢。
随后走到少女面前，温和地说了一句：“走吧，跟我回家。”
“谢仙师。”少女闻言，愣了半晌，慌乱地磕了个头。
然后怯生生地跟在李长生身后，但是因为害怕不敢靠得太近，始终跟李长生保持着三步的距离。
半响后。
李长生走出青云宗山门，心底有些不舍，转过头，回望一眼。
青云宗，七大主脉高耸入云，云雾缭绕。
仙鹤齐飞。
仙气绕绕。
偶尔头顶有高来高去的灵舟，载着新招收的弟子飞过。
青云门是他蹉跎了六十年的地方。
如今终究再见了。
从今天起，我就是吃人家烟火，知冷暖的，凡人李长生。
content_en:
"Get up."
"The sect has given birth to a wife. If we don't hurry up, we won't be able to get a beautiful wife."
"Chang Sheng, why are you still standing there? Come with me to get your wife."
Li Changsheng was awakened by the noise, opened his eyes, got up from the bed, and put on his Taoist robe.
Follow Wang Mazi to the outer gate square.
It was late autumn outside, and the cold wind penetrated along the sleeves, like a pure knife cutting flesh.
Li Changsheng is sixty years old this year.
For ordinary people, sixty years old is already a good year, with children and grandchildren around their knees;
But for immortal cultivators, if they are still stuck at the third level of Qi training at the age of sixty, it means that the avenue is cut off, leaving only a pile of dead bones that are about to decay.
He belongs to the latter.
When Li Changsheng walked to the outer gate square, the square was already full of people.
They are all optimized disciples, all of them are old, their beards and hair are white, and they are haggard.
Ahem...
On the high platform, the general affairs elder Xie Jian, dressed in brocade clothes, looked down at everyone, his voice was filled with spiritual power, cold and without any warmth:
"By order of the sect leader."
"In order to rectify the resources of the sect, all those who are over sixty and have not reached the middle stage of Qi training will be optimized and sent down the mountain from now on. Nian'er and others who have served the sect for many years can select a woman from the slaves of the subjugated country to become a Taoist companion and establish a mortal family."
"If the descendants have the qualifications to cultivate immortals, they can be sent to the sect, and the sect will receive many rewards."
As soon as Elder Xie Jian's voice fell, there was a commotion in the crowd.
He was forcibly dismissed and his wife was given away?
There is such a good thing.
The sect is really conscientious.
Li Changsheng stood where he was, looking quietly ahead.
It has been sixty years since he traveled to this world.
I walk on thin ice every day, not fighting or grabbing, and not messing with cause and effect.
I thought that as long as I could survive, I would always be able to survive.
But reality gave him a loud slap in the face.
If your qualifications are too poor, you will never get ahead even if you die.
This is the life of most mortals cultivating immortality.
In the world of immortality.
The workplace is more cruel than the previous life.
The sect does not support idle people. It drains the labor of people when they are young and kicks them away when they are old.
And let them go to the mortal world to serve as [reproductive machines].
Is this something a human being can do?
Elder Xie Jian waved his hand and said:
"Without further ado."
"Let's start choosing a wife."
After the words fell, the side door of the square
A group of women in ragged clothes and tired looks came out, driven by two law enforcement disciples.
These are all refugees from a subjugated country, who were reduced to slaves for some reason.
Then send her here to be the wife of these old men.
The eyes of the old disciples who were originally lifeless suddenly brightened up when they saw the beautiful woman in front of them.
The quality of the wives sent by Zongmen is not bad!
All of them are as beautiful as flowers and jade, with white skin and beautiful appearance.
And they are all girls between the ages of eighteen and thirty.
Maybe there are ladies of the family, descendants of powerful people, monks, and even the princess of the fallen country among them.
Can you choose a beautiful wife?
It depends on whether your hands are fast or your hands are slow.
"I choose this. I recognize him as someone from the Grand Duke's Mansion next door. He used to be a qi-training monk. It suits me just right."
"I choose this. White skin, big pelvis, good for fertility."
"I choose this. The clothes on her body make her look extraordinary, and she looks like a lady at first glance."
These optimized old men have chosen their favorite Taoist companions.
Only Li Changsheng did not move.
He's not in a hurry.
Because he doesn’t want any Taoist companions that others want.
Women are the source of trouble.
Especially these subjugated slaves.
Li Changsheng didn't want to be tainted by karma, so he just planned to choose an ordinary woman to live until she died of natural old age.
Then he saw that his friend Wang Mazi had chosen a fair-skinned and beautiful woman.
The woman was dressed in brocade and her skin was fairer than milk.
At first glance, she looks like a lady.
I really don’t know if Wang Mazi can bear this karma.
Li Changsheng complained in his heart.
At this time Wang Mazi walked up to Li Changsheng with a happy face and showed off:
"Longborn. "
"Is the wife I chose beautiful? "
Li Changsheng replied: "Beautiful. "
Wang Mazi became even more happy when he heard this. Li Changsheng's answer proved that he had good vision.
Then he saw Li Changsheng who was still motionless and asked doubtfully:
"Why don't you choose a wife? All the ladies who will be waiting for you have been picked out. "
Li Changsheng smiled honestly and honestly: "If I don't let you choose first, how can you choose a good wife? "
Wang Mazi laughed.
It seems so!
Li Changsheng is an iron fool.
How can such a thing be allowed?
Li Changsheng waited for a while, and then started to take action when everyone was almost ready.
Chen Waner.
This is so beautiful, it must be a disaster for beauty.
Liu Ruyi.
Is this a man of cultivation? But disaster.
Neither.
After Li Changsheng walked around, he selected a woman who had no cultivation, wore linen clothes, and looked very safe.
The woman saw Chen Mo coming over and hiding in the corner, trembling.
Li Changsheng raised his head and looked at the woman in front of him.
Timid?
It’s good to be timid!
Being timid means being in control.
Li Changsheng pointed at the girl in the corner and said:
"Elder. "
“The disciple wants to take her down the mountain. "
Hearing this, Xie Jian was stunned for a moment, raised his head and glanced at Li Changsheng, then turned his head and looked at the girl who had no cultivation and looked very safe, frowned and said:
"Li Changsheng, are you confused? "
"Jiang Cuiping is a mortal with no cultivation, why did you choose him? Then you choose those sin cultivators next to you! If you become a Taoist couple with a sin cultivator, it is easy to give birth to offspring with the qualifications for cultivation. "
When Li Changsheng heard this, his face was calm, his back was slightly bowed, and he showed a resigned smile.
“This disciple knows that his time is short and his money is tight. "
"I just want to find a mortal girl who knows both cold and hot, wash and cook, and provide for her until the end of her life. "
“I hope the elders will fulfill my wishes. "
Deacon Chen was silent for a while, then marked a mark on the roster:
"Okay. "
“Everyone has his own ambitions. "
"Jiang Cuiping, from today on, you can follow Li Changsheng down the mountain. "
"Thank you, elder. "Li Changsheng bowed his hands and thanked him.
Then he walked up to the girl and said gently: "Let's go home with me. "
"Thank you, Master Immortal. "When the girl heard this, she was stunned for a long time and kowtowed in panic.
Then he followed Li Changsheng timidly, but because he was afraid of getting too close, he always kept three steps away from Li Changsheng.
After a while.
Li Changsheng walked out of the Qingyun Sect's mountain gate, feeling a little reluctant in his heart. He turned his head and looked back.
In Qingyun Sect, the seven main veins tower into the clouds and are shrouded in mist.
The cranes flew together.
Fairy spirit surrounds.
Occasionally, there are spirit boats flying high above the head, carrying newly recruited disciples.
Qingyunmen is the place where he spent sixty years.
Now we meet again.
From today on, I will just eat other people's fireworks and know the warmth and coldness, a mortal Li Changsheng.
